blocks.text: Jin reactions mein reactants poori tarah kharch ho kar products ban jate hain, unhen irreversible reactions (sirf ek taraf chalne wali reactions) kehte hain. Aisi reaction us waqt ruk jati hai jab limiting reactant (jo reactant sab se pehle khatam ho) kharch ho jaye. Lekin kuch reactions dono taraf chalti rehti hain, yani forward (aage) aur reverse (wapas), aur maujooda halaat mein reactants aur products ki concentration nahi badalti. Aisi reactions kabhi nahi rukti aur reversible reactions kehlati hain. Jab reversible reaction aise container (bartan) mein ho jo kisi substance ko na andar aane de na bahar jane de, to kuch cheezen kharch hoti hain aur kuch banti hain, is liye in ki miqdar badalti rehti hai. Aakhir kar reaction ek stage par pohanch jati hai jise chemical equilibrium kehte hain. Is point par reactants aur products ki concentrations constant ho jati hain aur forward aur reverse reactions ki rates barabar ho jati hain.
Is chapter mein hum reversible processes ke equilibria parhenge, physical changes ke bhi aur chemical changes ke bhi. Kuch reversible reactions ki misalein yeh hain:
Double arrow (⇌) batata hai ke reaction reversible hai, yani dono taraf chal sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Irreversible reaction kyun ruk jati hai, jabke reversible reaction kabhi nahi rukti?
blocks.explanation: Irreversible reaction sirf ek taraf chalti hai, is liye limiting reactant khatam hote hi ruk jati hai. Reversible reaction mein products bhi aapas mein react kar ke dobara reactants banate hain. Dono reactions chalti rehti hain; equilibrium par in ki rates sirf barabar ho jati hain, is liye reaction asal mein kabhi nahi rukti.

items: Irreversible reaction limiting reactant khatam hone par ruk jati hai.
Reversible reaction dono taraf chalti hai (⇌) aur band container mein chemical equilibrium tak pohanchti hai: concentrations constant, forward aur reverse rates barabar.
Misalein: N₂ + 3H₂ ⇌ 2NH₃, 2NO₂ ⇌ N₂O₄, PCl₅ ⇌ PCl₃ + Cl₂.
